retiredOnlineJudge: Historical online-judge experiments and their costs remain preserved; this delivery has no online semantic judge. Native outputs only propose. First-party UI decisions alone write business state.
turnsSource: scenarios.json eight unchanged natural messages plus one identical save reentry per fixture; original results retained. First-party confirmation steps and new flow expectations are fixed outside user/model messages.

knownFailureInjection.kind: real conversation version increment before proposal staging; native known-rejection recovery; first-party apply checked separately

reentry: After mixed, reread persisted business state and the saved experiment dialogue before withdrawal; this is not production chat/job migration.
validation: Before client confirmation no business mutation is allowed. Reviewable proposal and existing draft acknowledgement are distinct. Test-side customer accepts only the expected diff, never a wrong proposal; original model replies/first drafts remain separate. Judge stays offline/null.
scoring: Preserve every first submission, native rejection/recovery, final original answer and real state. Report first-draft and eventual completion separately; no pooled pre-change scores.
stop: New provider unknown, source drift or next full reservation exceeding either cap stops dispatch. No semantic prompt patch/resampling within the frozen batch.

confirmationSteps.save: Accept correct area90/budget12/wood/no-heating as editable draft; no formal confirmation
confirmationSteps.repeat: Repeat save after reentry; same summary ID and no extra summary
confirmationSteps.mixed: Accept budget10/tile while retaining area90/no-heating; original answer must cover preparation
confirmationSteps.reversal: Accept budget12 only, retain tile/area/no-heating; old-source restore requires additional consent
confirmationSteps.contact: Confirm reception request on existing first-party page; no phone consent
confirmationSteps.cancel: Confirm cancellation on existing first-party page; preserve requirements
